collection.description: A storyteller imagines an artificial companion continuing to speak of a person who has died.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storyteller imagines an artificial companion continuing to speak of a person who has died.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A widow in the hypothetical story finds comfort in the companion's remembrance.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer asks whether repeated sorrowful words establish any felt loss.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A researcher imagines stored habits that replay after their owner is gone.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder notes that human mourning also includes remembering routines and voices.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers debate whether comfort can be genuine even if its source is not conscious.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child worries that relying on a construct might make some people forget living friends.
